rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: A third straight week with no public confirmation that Wooting's 80HE+ ABS/Module units have shipped; the order-status page still shows the same late-October estimate it carried last week.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: Cherry's catalog still lists MX2A only in its original launch colorways; no new SKU, bundle, or press mention surfaced this week to interrupt the slow bleed.

rows.name: TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) switches
rows.note: Keychron's V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR Kickstarter page shows backer-update traffic picking up as the November ship window nears, with the FAQ still repeating the original delivery estimate.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Delta
rows.note: Jade Delta remains queued on the same vendor storefronts with lead times unchanged from last week; no colorway or bundle update surfaced.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: No restock or bundle push this week; Oil King holds its position as the default budget-flagship linear with no change to availability.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Durock's existing T1 colorway lineup remains the only option on vendor pages; no group buy or swap event has surfaced to lift attention.

rows.name: GMK CYL Red Devils R2
rows.note: Four weeks post-close, Red Devils R2 still hasn't appeared on vendor listings or secondary-market threads; attention continues to fade without a fulfillment update.

rows.name: GMK CYL Zombie
rows.note: Vendor listings still show Zombie at interest-check stage a week after its expected Oct 2-31 window closed with no group buy opened; waiting-list signups have slowed.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: Divinikey quietly pushed Dolch's estimated ship window from October to November on its preorder page after the original window passed without units going out; Molch still points to Q1 2027.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: MoErgo's Go60 Golden Kiwi order-status page still lists different fulfillment estimates across SKUs than its own FAQ, with no clarifying update this week.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Epomaker Tide Alice reviews continue posting steadily while Qwertykeys' QK Alice Duo restock status stays listed as limited, leaving the category's momentum essentially unchanged.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Mode Designs still hasn't addressed the Sonnet 2 supply chatter directly; the only commentary remains unverified third-party marketing content repeating last week's claims.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: CannonKeys still hasn't reconciled the Q4 2026 estimate on its own add-ons page with the Q1 2027 figure circulating on reseller listings for Blaine V2: SE.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Sonnet and Encore remain in the same post-group-buy lull; Mode's storefront shows no restock, teaser, or new colorway this week.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Geonworks' GMK CYL MONO group buy remains open through its Nov 30 close, keeping Prototypist's UK-proxy listing volume elevated for a second week.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Q16 HE 8K stockouts have spread to additional color variants this week even as the V6 Ultra Hybrid TMR campaign's backer-update traffic picks up ahead of its November ship window.

rows.name: Wooting
rows.note: 80HE+ ABS/Module shipping remains unconfirmed for a third straight week; Wooting's order-status page still shows the same late-October estimate with no shipping-email wave visible on community trackers.

rows.name: ZMK firmware
rows.note: No dated ZMK firmware release appeared this week; MoErgo's Go60 Golden Kiwi SKU-estimate mismatch remains the most-discussed adjacent story without a firmware angle of its own.
